prerequisites: All 21 Product IDs created in Creator Dashboard
Product IDs wired into GamePassConfig.lua and DevProductsConfig.lua

decisions.decision: 7-phase QA test plan with concrete pass/fail criteria for Studio execution

tests: Server Boot (no errors) - verify Output shows UnifiedServer init messages
Client Boot - HUD visible, no script errors
ReceiptRouter Diagnostics - 16 dev products + 5 game passes registered, zero conflicts
Wave System Start - enemies spawn, health bars visible
Combat (Kill → Coins → Combo) - combat rewards manager awards coins
Enemy Types Match EnemyData - stages 1-3 enemies correct
Boss Wave (Wave 5) - WorldBoss spawns with unique attack pattern
Day Scaling - difficulty ramps visibly
Game Pass Purchase Flow (5 passes) - each activates immediately, persists
Dev Product Purchase Flow (sample 4) - ReceiptRouter processes each
No Dual ProcessReceipt - exactly one processed per purchase
EconomyManager Coin Flow - balance decreases correctly
SecurityLayer Validation - no exploit warnings
DataStore Save/Load - coins/XP/level/inventory persist
Daily Rewards - UI appears, rewards granted
Battle Pass - tier progress visible
Leaderboard - player stats display
Prestige - resets progress, grants prestige rewards
FTUE - tutorial sequence completes
Mobile Controls - touch buttons appear, responsive
Gacha/Crate Opening - animation plays, item added
Cosmetic Equip - visual change applies
Analytics Events Firing - join/kill/purchase/wave_complete/death logged
Anomaly Detector - no false positives
All Phase 1-6 tests pass
Store listing uploaded
Thumbnail + icon uploaded
Game set to Public
AllowThirdPartySales = true

principles.text: Every test item is concrete with exact pass/fail criteria
principles.interpretation: No subjective judgment — expected Output messages, exact expected behaviors defined.

principles.text: Module names match actual repo files
principles.interpretation: 48 files verified against actual CANON/TRAIN-67/CODE/ contents.

principles.text: Tests are copy-pasteable and executable in Studio
principles.interpretation: Michael can run through the checklist in Studio test mode.
